private.label: Private
private.description: Only you see these conversations. For the rest of the team they don't show up, not even in the timeline.

metadata.label: Metadata only
metadata.description: The team sees subject, participants and dates, but not the content, preview or attachments.

shared.label: Shared
shared.description: Anyone who can see the linked record reads the full conversation, with content and attachments.

errors.mail_provider_authentication: The provider rejected the username or password
errors.mail_provider_connection: Could not connect to the mail server
errors.mail_provider_rejected: The mail server rejected the message
errors.mail_provider_unsupported: The provider does not support this feature

mailboxes.title: Email mailboxes
mailboxes.description: Connect your mailbox so messages exchanged with customers show up on records, and send emails from Aphel.
mailboxes.connectHint: Use your Google or Microsoft account, or enter your provider's IMAP and SMTP servers.
mailboxes.noProviders: No email provider is available in this organization.
mailboxes.emptyDescription: Connect a mailbox to sync and send emails from records.
mailboxes.connectDescription: The password is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
mailboxes.connected: Mailbox connected. The first sync has started.
mailboxes.removeDescription: The synced conversations of this mailbox and its stored password will be deleted from Aphel. Nothing is deleted at your email provider.

oauthErrors.access_denied: Authorization was cancelled at the provider.
oauthErrors.invalid_state: The connection session expired. Try again.
oauthErrors.exchange_failed: The provider did not confirm the authorization. Try again.

form.historyHint: How many days back to import on the first sync (up to {{max}}).
form.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the current one
form.visibilityHint: Applies to the conversations of this mailbox. You can change it per conversation later.

editorDescription.organization: Template available to the whole team.

scopeDescription.organization: Templates the whole team can use when writing an email.
scopeDescription.personal: Templates of your own, listed next to the organization ones when writing.

templates.emptyDescription: Create templates so you don't rewrite the usual messages.
templates.name: Name
templates.keyHint: Stable identifier, used by configuration packages. Lowercase letters, numbers and _.
templates.bodyHint: Use simple HTML (paragraphs, bold, links). Variables such as {{example}} are replaced with the record data.
templates.removeDescription: Emails already sent with this template don't change.

preview.missingVariables: Some variables have no value in the preview:

settings.title: Email
settings.description: Organization templates, addresses kept out of the CRM, tracking and contact capture.

blocklist.description: Messages from or to these domains and addresses are not synced or linked to records. Use it for personal and internal domains and newsletters.

invalid.domain: Enter a valid domain, such as example.com.

blocklist.removeDescription: Upcoming messages from this sender will be synced again. Older ones are not recovered.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.description: Know when emails sent from Aphel are opened and when their links are clicked.
tracking.opensDescription: Adds an invisible image to the message. Some email clients block images, so an open may not be counted.
tracking.clicksDescription: Links go through an Aphel redirect before reaching their destination.
tracking.defaultOn: On by default for new emails
tracking.defaultOnDescription: Senders can still turn tracking off for each email.
tracking.privacyNote: Recipients who objected to data processing are never tracked.
tracking.disabledForMessage: Tracking was off for this email.

capture.title: Contact capture
capture.description: What Aphel may create or link on its own from synced emails. Everything starts off.
capture.createContactsDescription: Only when messages were exchanged both ways with the address.
capture.createCompaniesDescription: Personal email domains and blocklisted ones are ignored.
capture.linkOpenDealsDescription: The conversation also shows up on the contact's open deals.
capture.initialHistoryHint: Suggested when new mailboxes are connected.

tab.label: Emails
tab.description: Email conversations linked to this record.
tab.emptyDescription: When you exchange emails with this record, the conversations show up here.
tab.emptyNoMailbox: Connect your mailbox to see and send messages from here.
tab.noMailboxTitle: You haven't connected a mailbox yet
tab.noMailboxDescription: Connect it to sync your conversations and send emails from the record.

reader.metadataNotice: {{name}} shares only the metadata of this conversation: subject, participants and dates.
reader.remoteImagesBlocked: Remote images blocked to protect your privacy.
reader.cancelDescription: The message will not be sent. You can write another one later.

links.automaticHint: Linked automatically from the conversation participants.
links.title: Link to a record
links.description: The conversation will show up in the Emails tab and in the timeline of the chosen record.
links.alreadyLinked: The conversation is already linked to this record.
links.unlinkTitle: Unlink the conversation from this record?
links.unlinkDescription: The conversation no longer shows up on the record. It stays in your mailbox.

composer.title: New email
composer.description: The message is sent from your connected mailbox and linked to this record.
composer.htmlHint: Simple HTML. Scripts and active content are removed when sending.
composer.scheduleInvalid: Pick a date and time in the future.
composer.trackingHint: Only you see the tracking results.
